name: Healthy Lifestyle
overview: Scripture teaches that a healthy lifestyle honors God by caring for the body He has given us, as seen in the provision of natural foods like herbs and fruits from creation (Genesis 1:29) and the allowance of all living creatures for nourishment (Genesis 9:3). A joyful heart promotes healing and vitality, while a broken spirit harms the body (Proverbs 17:22). True freedom and strength for living well come through knowing the truth of Christ (John 8:32), persevering in faith amid trials (Acts 14:22), and offering our bodies as living sacrifices dedicated to God’s service (Romans 12:1).
